description: TodoWrite mutates nothing but the agent's own task list, which the harness mirrors into the UI as the run's progress view (see src/agent/todos.ts). Allowed unconditionally: gating it behind a human approval would stall the run on the one tool whose entire purpose is telling the human what's happening. Routed through the filter engine (rather than a bare `allowedTools` entry) so the decision still lands in tool_events like every other tool call.
